dialogue.origin: （本日は、よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for coming today. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: （16：30になりましたら始めたいと思います。）
dialogue.content: (I'd like to begin at 4:30 PM.)

dialogue.origin: 了解致しました
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。今日こちらでお話されたことは許可なく外部に漏れる事は一切ありませんので、どうぞ安心してお話してください。 初めに、年齢と性別をお聞かせいただけますか。
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm your counselor. Please be assured that everything you share here today is strictly confidential and will not be disclosed to anyone without your permission, so please feel free to speak openly. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 49歳女性です、よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: I'm a 49-year-old woman. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただきありがとうございます。こちらこをよろしくお願いいたします。それでは、今日お話されたい事をお聞かせいただけますか。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. It's a pleasure to work with you. Now, could you please tell me what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 実は、実妹と義理妹が仲が悪く、それによって私たち兄弟や両親も今まで通り行かなくなりギクシャクしてちょっと辛いです。
dialogue.content: Actually, my younger sister and my sister-in-law don't get along, and because of that, things have become strained and awkward for my siblings and parents. We can't interact as we used to, and it's a bit painful for me.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。それはお辛い状況ですよね・・・今は、皆さんどのように過ごされているのですか？例えば、お近くに住まれているのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. That sounds like a very difficult situation. How is everyone managing now? For example, do you all live near each other?

dialogue.origin: 義理妹が一方的に妹を露骨に無視するみたいなんです。二人はめちゃくちゃ近所に住んでいるのですが、道で合ったり、お店などで偶然会ったとしても、完全に無視されるみたいで、なぜかわからない妹は精神的に参っているみたいで。
dialogue.content: It seems my sister-in-law blatantly and one-sidedly ignores my sister. They live extremely close by, and even if they pass each other on the street or run into each other at a shop, she's completely ignored. My sister doesn’t know why, and it seems to be taking a mental toll on her.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただきありがとうございます。それは、妹さんがとても辛い状況ですね。義理の妹さんとは弟さんのお嫁さんで間違いなかったでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. That must be a very painful situation for your sister. Just to confirm, your sister-in-law is your younger brother's wife, is that correct?

dialogue.origin: 義理妹は私の実弟の妻です。
dialogue.content: Yes, my sister-in-law is my younger brother's wife.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。お近くに住まれている妹さんと、義理の妹さんはもともと知り合いだったとか？地元が一緒だとか、何か共通点があったりしますか。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Did your sister and sister-in-law, who live so close, know each other beforehand? Were they from the same hometown, or do they have anything else in common?

dialogue.origin: お互い子どもが同じ小学校で一人は同じクラスのようです。私も両親も弟と妹同じくらい大切なので、露骨に妹ばかりの味方をするのも良く無いし、でも無視するなんて最低な行為なので、義理妹は正直私は嫌いです。言わないですが
dialogue.content: Their children go to the same elementary school, and it seems one of them is in the same class. My parents and I care about both my brother and sister equally, so it wouldn't be right to openly side only with my sister. But ignoring someone is such a terrible thing to do, so honestly, I dislike my sister-in-law. Though I'd never say it.

dialogue.origin: 間違えました。学年が同じだけでクラスは違いました
dialogue.content: I made a mistake. They’re in the same grade but in different classes.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そうでしたか。それは心配ですよね。同じ小学校で同じ学年ですね。では、弟さんと妹さんの関係はいかがですか。
dialogue.content: I see. That's certainly worrying. So their children are in the same grade at the same elementary school. What is the relationship like between your brother and your sister?

dialogue.origin: 妹は元々義理妹が苦手なタイプだったので、弟とは仲良くしたかったみたいですが、遠慮してあまり交流は持っていなかったようです
dialogue.content: My sister was never very fond of my sister-in-law's type of personality. She wanted to get along with my brother, but she held back and didn't interact with them much.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。妹さんのお気持ちを察すると気の毒な気もしますね。お姉さまから見ても、みんな家族ですし、本当に心配ですよね。義理の妹さんが露骨に無視するようになったという妹さんから何か具体的な話は聞いていらっしゃいますか。
dialogue.content: I see. I can imagine how your sister must feel, and I feel for her. From your perspective as the older sister, they're all family, so it's truly worrying. Have you heard any specific details from your sister about when or why your sister-in-law started blatantly ignoring her?

dialogue.origin: 全く聞いていないのです。それに普段ほとんど関わりがなかったので身に覚えがないみたいだし。弟はあまり揉め事に関わりたく無いタイプです。義理妹にもあまり強く言わないんじゃないかと。気が強そうなので。実妹も割とおとなしいですが頑固なところはあります。
dialogue.content: I haven’t heard anything at all. They hardly interacted usually, so she has no idea what might have caused it. My brother is the type who doesn’t want to get involved in conflicts. I doubt he’d speak firmly to his wife—she seems strong-willed. My sister is fairly quiet but has a stubborn side.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そうでしたか。ご家族が皆さん優しい印象を受けますね。妹さんと弟さんはどちらが年齢が上になりますか。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like everyone in your family is quite gentle. Between your sister and your brother, who is older?

dialogue.origin: 弟です
dialogue.content: My brother.

dialogue.origin: 弟さんが妹さんからみてお兄様になるのですね。では、義理の妹さんと妹さんはどうなりますか。
dialogue.content: So your brother is your sister's older brother, I see. Then, between your sister-in-law and your sister, who is older?

dialogue.origin: 妹が一学年上です。
dialogue.content: My sister is one school year older.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。それでは、妹さんの方が年齢は上ですが、お子様の学年が同じという事ですね。では、お子様同士の性別はどうでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. So your sister is older, but their children are in the same grade. What about the genders of the children?

dialogue.origin: 義理妹は男のこ妹は女の子です
dialogue.content: My sister-in-law has a boy, and my sister has a girl.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。お子様の学年が同じで、性別は違うという事ですね。二人とも可愛い甥と姪ですし、二人は仲良く過ごされていると思われますか。
dialogue.content: Thank you. So their children are in the same grade but are different genders. They are your dear nephew and niece; do you think the two of them get along well?

dialogue.origin: クラスも5クラスあり離れているし、性別も違うのでほとんど遊ばないと思います
dialogue.content: There are five classes in their grade, so they're in different ones, and since they're different genders, I don't think they play together much.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。ありがとうございます。妹さんからすると、同じ学校に通っている家族同士仲良く過ごしたいと思うことは当然だと思うのですが、なぜそれが難しくなってしまったのか？ご家族から見て、なにか心当たりはありそうでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you. From your sister's perspective, it's natural to want to get along as family members whose children attend the same school. Why has that become so difficult? From your family's point of view, is there any idea what might have happened?

dialogue.origin: だから実際に無視される具体的なことが全く心当たりがないので、改善できないんです。でもひたすら無視されるから、親族の集まりも同じ日に集まれなくなってしまいました。
dialogue.content: That's the thing, there's absolutely no known reason for the ignoring, so we can't fix it. But because she's just constantly ignored, we can no longer have family gatherings on the same day.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。。。心当たりが全くないという事ですね。失礼いたしました。先ほど、義理の妹さんの事をあまり好きじゃないと表現されていたと思うのですが、なぜそう思うのか具体的にそう思われる要因となるエピソード等ありましたらお聞かせいただけますか。
dialogue.content: I see... So there's no known cause at all. My apologies. Earlier, I believe you mentioned that you don't particularly like your sister-in-law. Could you tell me if there are any specific episodes or reasons why you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 割と賑やかなタイプで、キャピキャピしてますし、ちょっと意地悪っぽいというか…和より自己主張が強いというか…クラスにいる派手なタイプって感じかな
dialogue.content: She's a rather lively, bubbly type, and she seems a bit mean-spirited... or rather, more self-assertive than harmonious... kind of like the flashy type you'd find in a classroom.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。少し派手目の印象を受けますね。こちらも、質問ばかりして申し訳ございません。なぜ、大切な妹さんを無視するような態度をとられるのか私もとても気になるのですが、親族の集まりを同じ日にできないのはなぜでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like she gives off a bit of a flashy impression. I'm sorry for asking so many questions. I'm also very curious why she would ignore your dear sister, but could you tell me why you can't have family gatherings on the same day?

dialogue.origin: 妹が義理妹に会いたく無いからです
dialogue.content: Because my sister doesn’t want to see my sister-in-law.

dialogue.origin: せっかくの親族の集まりなのに残念ですね。そのことを弟さんと話されたことはありますか。
dialogue.content: It's a shame, especially for a family gathering. Have you ever spoken with your brother about this?

dialogue.origin: ないです。弟は女同士のいさかいに口をはさみたくないみたいだし、くだらないと言えばくだらない話ですし。
dialogue.content: No, I haven't. My brother doesn't seem to want to get involved in women's squabbles, and if you think about it, it is a rather trivial matter.

dialogue.origin: 私は妹が元気がなくて、わたしや両親とも会わなくなってきたのが辛いです。
dialogue.content: It's painful for me that my sister has lost her spirit and has started avoiding seeing me and our parents.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。妹さんが一番お辛いですよね。弟さんには話が出来なかった事を他の誰かと話したりしていますか。
dialogue.content: I see. Your sister must be having the hardest time. Have you been able to talk with anyone else about what you couldn't discuss with your brother?

dialogue.origin: 両親と私とでは散々話しましたが、無視する理由は考えても全くわからないし、妹も見に覚えがないし気にするなとしか言えなくて。気にするなと言われても近所だと気になりますよね。引っ越しすれば？とも言いましたが、子どもが学校好きだから転校したくないと…妹は一人で我慢してて可哀想で
dialogue.content: I've talked about it a lot with my parents, but we can't figure out the reason for her being ignored, and my sister has no idea either, so all we can say is "don't worry about it." But it's hard not to worry when they live so close. I even suggested she move, but she said her child loves school and doesn't want to transfer... I feel so sorry for my sister, enduring this all alone.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。何度も話し合っているのになかなか解決できずにもどかしいですよね。義理の妹さんは何とおっしゃっていますか。
dialogue.content: I see. It must be frustrating that you've talked it over so many times without a solution. What does your sister-in-law say about it?

dialogue.origin: 仕方ないとは言ってますが、明らかに辛そうです。ママ友作ったら？と言ったら、ママ友になろうとしても義理妹と知り合いが多くてうまく行かないそうです。
dialogue.content: She says it can't be helped, but she's clearly in pain. When I suggested she make some "mom friends," she said it's difficult because many of them are acquaintances of my sister-in-law.

dialogue.origin: 妹さん、お辛そうですね。義理の妹さんがママ友の中でも目立つようですね。お姉さまも義理の妹さんは苦手だとお聞きしましたが、義理の妹さんとは話せそうですか。
dialogue.content: Your sister sounds like she's having a very hard time. It seems your sister-in-law is quite prominent among the other mothers. I know you said you also find your sister-in-law difficult, but do you think you could talk to her?

dialogue.origin: 私は話そうと思えば話せますが多分妹がすごい嫌がると思います。私と妹はなかなか会えない距離に住んでいて、なかなか会えないですし、最近は人に会うのが億劫のようで、鬱っぽくなってるか心配です。
dialogue.content: I could talk to her if I tried, but I think my sister would really hate that. My sister and I live far apart, so we can't see each other often, and lately she seems to find meeting people burdensome. I'm worried she might be becoming depressed.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。義理の妹さんより、妹さんの様子がとても気になりますね。妹さんをケアできる方、近くにいらっしゃいますか。
dialogue.content: I see. More than your sister-in-law, I'm very concerned about how your sister is doing. Is there anyone nearby who can support her?

dialogue.origin: 友達もいなさそうだし、両親が行っても最近は拒否するようです。義理妹は私がそういう文句のような話したら、私の前ではおとなしく話を聞くかもしれませんが、そのストレスを弟にぶつけるタイプです。だから弟が可哀想なので。我々家族の中で義理妹は腫れ物扱いです。
dialogue.content: She doesn’t seem to have friends, and recently she's been turning our parents away, even when they go to visit. As for my sister-in-law, if I were to complain to her about it, she might quietly listen to my face, but she’s the type to take that stress out on my brother. That's why I feel sorry for my brother. Within our family, we treat my sister-in-law like we're treading on eggshells.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。それはお辛いですね。妹さんの様子を伺っていると、今すぐ義理の妹さんを問い詰めたい気持ちになりますが、義理の妹さんが急に優しくなったら妹さんは元の元気な姿に戻ると思いますか、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. That is very difficult. Hearing about your sister makes me feel like I want to confront your sister-in-law right away, but if your sister-in-law were to suddenly start being kind, do you think your sister would go back to her usual cheerful self? What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そう思います。
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: 私も問い詰めたい気持ちがすごくあります。本人しかわからないですよね
dialogue.content: I also have a strong desire to confront her. Only she knows the reason, right?

dialogue.origin: そうですか。人を無視する行為は許されない行為だと思います。妹さんの落込む原因が義理の妹さんにあるというのは確実ですね。お姉さまが、先ほども弟さんとの関係をとても気にされていましたが、ここは天秤にかけることなく妹さんを救うことはできないでしょうか。どう思われますか。
dialogue.content: I see. Ignoring someone is an unacceptable act. It seems certain that your sister-in-law is the cause of your sister’s distress. You mentioned being very concerned about your relationship with your brother, but might this be a time to help your sister without weighing it against that relationship? What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれません。
dialogue.content: That might be true.

dialogue.origin: でも妹が弟に聞いたら、私も妹に嫌われそうで
dialogue.content: But if my sister hears that I asked my brother about it, I'm afraid she might end up disliking me too.

dialogue.origin: 人は孤独や苦痛を長い間経験すると気持ちがコントロールできなくなります。うつ状態になる人も多いと思います。今は、弟さんとの関係よりは妹さんの気持ちが大事ではないかと思いますが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: When people experience loneliness or distress for a long time, it can become hard to manage their emotions. Many people can fall into a depressive state. Right now, I wonder if your sister’s feelings are more important than your relationship with your brother—how does that sound to you?

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさい、間違えました。私が勝手に聞いたら妹にすごい怒られそう
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I misspoke. If I ask him on my own, my sister would probably get really angry at me.

dialogue.origin: 妹さんは、兄と姉の心配をしているのですね。
dialogue.content: Your sister is worried about her brother and sister, isn't she?

dialogue.origin: 本当に優しい方ですね。
dialogue.content: She's a very kind person, isn't she?

dialogue.origin: お姉さまが心配するのも無理もないですね。とても愛おしい存在だと思いますし、妹さんもそんなお姉さまやお兄様が大好きなんですね。素敵です。
dialogue.content: It's no wonder you're so worried. I'm sure she's very dear to you, and your sister must love her older sister and brother very much. That's wonderful.

dialogue.origin: 妹はこの問題にタッチして欲しく無いみたいです。
dialogue.content: It seems my sister doesn’t want us to get involved in this issue.

dialogue.origin: 今までお話を伺ってきたことを少し纏めますと。。。ご家族の関係がとても良いと思います。お子さん同士も特に問題がないと思いますが、義理の妹さんがすこし厄介な行動をとられやすい傾向にあり、ご家族が翻弄されている様に思えますがいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: To summarize what I’ve heard so far… your family relationships seem very good. There doesn’t appear to be any particular issue between the children, but it seems your sister-in-law tends to engage in somewhat troublesome behavior, and your family is being affected by it. Does that sound right to you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もちろん、お嫁さんとして家族になられた義理の妹さんも含めて家族ですので、全員が仲良く過ごすことが理想なのですが、今は遠く離れた家族や、いろんなケースがあるので、仲良く。。とは言いませんが、せめて、家族同士無視する行為や、傷つける行為については解決する必要があると思いますが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Of course, your sister-in-law who joined your family through marriage is also family, so the ideal is for everyone to get along. But these days, with families living far apart and in many different situations, I won't say you all have to get along... but at the very least, I believe the act of ignoring or hurting a family member needs to be resolved. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I agree.

dialogue.origin: カウンセラーさんはどうすればいいと思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think I should do, Counselor?

dialogue.origin: お子様同士よく見本にはならないと思いますよね。子供が小さいうちに一日でも早く元の元気な妹さんに戻っていただきたいと思いますが、お姉さまができること何かを一緒に考えたい思いますが。
dialogue.content: It's not a good example for the children, is it? I'm sure you want your sister to return to her cheerful self as soon as possible, while the children are still young, and I'd like to think together with you about what you, as her older sister, can do.

dialogue.origin: お姉さまのやさしさを強さに帰るのはいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: How about turning your kindness into strength?

dialogue.origin: 変えるのはです。失礼しました。
dialogue.content: I meant "turning it into." My apologies.

dialogue.origin: 具体的には何かありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have anything specific in mind?

dialogue.origin: 妹さんは、家族の絆が壊れると思ってお兄さんにもお姉さんにも助けを求めないと思いますので、お姉さんが弟さんと妹さんとよく話す事が大事じゃないかな。。。と思います。
dialogue.content: I believe your sister isn't asking for help from you or your brother because she's afraid it will break the family bond. So, I think it's important for you, as the older sister, to talk things over thoroughly with both your brother and your sister.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。弟と話してみようかと思います。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I see. I think I’ll try talking with my brother. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 弟さんに了承を得て、義理の妹さんにお話しをされるのがいいか。弟さんがお嫁さんに話す事が良いのかを話し合ってみるのはいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: How about discussing with your brother whether it would be better for you to speak to your sister-in-law after getting his approval, or if it would be better for him to speak to his wife?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、そうしてみます。今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, I’ll try that. Thank you for today.

dialogue.origin: ご家族全員がとても優しい印象を受けたので、注意することは人を責めることだと思われているかもしれませんね。やさしさが時には強さにもなると思います。義理の妹さんもきっとわかってくれると思います。頑張ってください。
dialogue.content: I got the impression that everyone in your family is very kind, so perhaps you feel that pointing something out is the same as blaming someone. I believe that kindness can also be a strength sometimes. I'm sure your sister-in-law will understand. All the best.

dialogue.origin: お話をお聞かせいただきありがとうございました。今日、話したいことは話せましたか？今日はこのあたりにしたいと思うのですがいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing your story with me. Were you able to talk about everything you wanted to today? I think this is a good place to stop for today, how does that sound?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。あたたかいご家族の話またお聞かせください。それでは、今日はこれで終了とさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. Please tell me more about your warm family again sometime. With that, we'll conclude our session for today.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。お疲れさまでした。またよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you. Good work today. I look forward to next time.)

dialogue.origin: ロールプレイを終了いたします。
dialogue.content: This concludes the role-play.

dialogue.origin: （よろしいでしょうか）
dialogue.content: (Is that alright?)

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

topic.sub: 実妹と義理妹の関係悪化による家族の葛藤
